text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx rate on streaming/paged gateway in us-west-2 — error rate 12% over last 5m. Paging route shows client disconnects and chunked-encoding resets. Paging impact: streaming responses failing to deliver chunks. Incident severity: P1.
Maya S (oncall): I’m on it. grabbing dashboard now — what’s the customer impact?
Ben L (CS): Seeing inbound from 3 customers reporting aborted streams, one enterprise (AcmeCorp) is reporting timeouts in their file ingestion pipeline.
Alex R: Quick diff — any deploys to gateway / proxy in last 30m?
Priya K: No prod deploys in the last hour. There was a config change to nginx buffer sizing 2h ago but it rolled back.
Josh T: Confirming: logs show a spike of "client prematurely closed connection" with chunked frames: repeated 502/504 from gateway to runtime.
Maya S (oncall): Can someone paste the relevant log lines?
Josh T: here, from gateway logs around 2130001100:
```
[2130001101] gateway | upstream response error: short read on chunked transfer: unexpected EOF
[2130001102] gateway | proxy_read_timeout after 5s while reading response header from upstream
[2130001103] gateway | 502 while reading response header from upstream
```
Maya S (oncall): Runtime logs?
Alex R: Runtime shows lots of partial stream cancellations with KV cache misses then immediate client reset. snippet:
```
2026-09-18T14:05:43Z runtime | session=abc123 token=... stream: wrote 0/256 bytes, client cancelled
2026-09-18T14:05:44Z runtime | session=def456 model=gpt-4-mini quantized: chunked write failed: EPIPE
```
Maya S (oncall): Hypothesis: gateway is timing out while runtime stalls on heavy prefix caching and client cancels => upstream 5xx bubbled. We should failover traffic to non-paged streaming path or to smaller model variant.
Priya K: Can we flip the routing policy quickly? I can push a temporary rule to route streaming/paged -> streaming/fallback-nopaging in the next 60s. That will break some streaming optimization but preserve connections.
Ben L (CS): That would help AcmeCorp immediately, they can tolerate non-optimized stream for now.
Maya S (oncall): Do the failover. Also increase gateway proxy_read_timeout to 15s as short-term mitigation.
Priya K: Pushing change now: applying route override for streaming/paged -> streaming/fallback-nopaging. Also increasing proxy_read_timeout to 15s.
IncidentBot: Deploy bot: change streaming route override applied by Priya K at 2130001360.
Alex R: After routing override, runtime metrics show 60% drop in 5xx rate from 12% -> 4% in first 2m. Good sign.
Josh T: Gateway error logs now show fewer chunked EOFs. We still see client cancellations but less upstream 502s.
Maya S (oncall): Collect sample request IDs for impacted requests so CS can notify customers.
Josh T: sample request IDs: rq_0a1b2, rq_0b2c3, rq_0c3d4 (from 2130001200-2130001280).
Ben L (CS): Thanks — I'll reach out to AcmeCorp and the other two customers with initial mitigation note and ETA for permanent fix.
Alex R: Root cause debugging notes: I’m seeing a pattern where long-lived streaming sessions with highly fragmented token output cause repeated kernel stalls in the quantized execution path when KV cache refresh happens -> runtime stalls for 200-400ms, gateway times out at 5s when multiple stalls accumulate. Also some older clients appear to cancel aggressively when chunk latency spikes.
Maya S (oncall): Next steps: 1) keep route override for now, 2) instrument more detailed streaming latency histograms (per-chunk lat), 3) run canary of a runtime patch that avoids synchronous KV cache refresh during streaming.
Priya K: Rolling out the timeout change globally might affect other flows, so keep it scoped to the streaming proxy for now. We can revert in 1h after stabilization.
Josh T: Adding quick metric panels to incident dashboard: per-chunk p50/p95 latency, upstream 502/504 counts, client cancel rate, active streaming sessions.
Alex R: I’ll prepare a runtime patch branch that defers KV cache maintenance to background worker for active streaming sessions. Can build a canary container to deploy to one nodepool.
Maya S (oncall): Do we have permission to route AcmeCorp traffic to fallback region? That’s an option if they keep seeing issues.
Priya K: We can, but prefer in-region fallback first. Region failover would require an additional support ticket.
Ben L (CS): AcmeCorp is ok with in-region fallback for the next 2h while engineering works on the fix.
IncidentBot: Pager update: Severity remains P1. Affected customers flagged: AcmeCorp (enterprise), BetaStream (SaaS), DataFlow Inc.
Maya S (oncall): Estimated customer impact: ~0.8% of total streaming sessions, but concentrated on high-QPS enterprise flows -> business impact high.
Alex R: Canary built, pushing runtime change to canary pool now. Build ID: runtime-canary-2130001500.
Priya K: Canary deploy started at 2130001620 to 2 nodes.
Josh T: Monitoring canary: chunk latency p95 down 35% on canary nodes. No new 502s observed from those nodes.
Maya S (oncall): Good. If canary holds for 10m, start rolling patch.
Alex R: Rolling patch to 25% capacity at 2130001800. Patch includes background KV maintenance + more forgiving backpressure for chunk flush.
Ben L (CS): Messaging update sent to affected customers at 2130001700 — noted mitigation and that we’re rolling a runtime patch.
Maya S (oncall): Postmortem owners? Alex R + Priya K + Josh T. Ben L will own customer comms.
Alex R: Agreed. Action items captured: 
- (Alex) finalize patch rollout and watch for regressions
- (Priya) keep route override until rollback criteria met (5xx <1% for 30m)
- (Josh) add per-chunk histogram and trace sampling for streaming sessions
- (Ben) send follow-up to customers when patch rolled to 100%
IncidentBot: Incident update logged. Next handoff scheduled at 2130002400 if still active.
Maya S (oncall): Handoff notes for next oncall: current mitigations active: route override to fallback, proxy timeout = 15s, runtime patch rolling 25% -> target 100% if stable. Watch for spike in client cancel rate after rollback.
Josh T: Leaving a snippet to reproduce locally (useful for postmortem):
```
# simulate slow chunk production and client cancel
python tools/sim_stream.py --model gpt-4-mini --chunk-delay 0.35 --client-timeout 2.5
```
Maya S (oncall): Thanks team. I’m going to step out for a break — handover to night oncall if needed. Keep updates short and paste critical metrics.
Alex R: Will update when patch hits 100%.
Priya K: Keeping route override until 5xx < 1% for 30m; setting reminder.
Ben L (CS): Customer impact summary: AcmeCorp experienced 40% of their streams affected for ~12 minutes; fallback restored service for them. Other customers had intermittent aborts.
IncidentBot: [RESOLVE CHECKPOINT] At 2130001920 mitigation in place, 5xx at 0.9% (meets rollback threshold). Marking for controlled rollback planning.
Maya S (oncall): Closing active triage. Will open follow-up ticket and postmortem. Thanks all."
